summary: Structure infrastructure finance, assess guarantees and viability gaps, and track development outcomes. Explore this practical five-day course.
lede: Blended finance training helps public finance officials, PPP teams and development-finance professionals assess infrastructure transactions. Participants practise screening project readiness, testing bankability and affordability in financial models, comparing concessional funding options, mapping risks and guarantees, evaluating procurement choices, and setting indicators to monitor development outcomes.
audienceIntro: This blended finance course is designed for professionals who shape, assess, procure or oversee infrastructure and development transactions involving public, concessional and private capital.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with public finance, infrastructure projects, development finance, procurement or project delivery. No coding is required. Excel familiarity will help with financial-model exercises; advanced financing structures and AI-assisted screening receive operational or conceptual coverage rather than implementation training.
